antigen_expressing_prevalence.label: Antigen expressing prevalence
antigen_expressing_prevalence.plain_english: What fraction of tumors express target above a clinically relevant level (patient-selection prevalence)?

dosage_sensitivity_safety.label: Dosage sensitivity safety
dosage_sensitivity_safety.plain_english: Is single-copy loss of target pathogenic (ClinGen autosomal-dominant / haploinsufficiency safety)?

expression_purity_confound.label: Expression purity confound

normal_tissue_protein_abundance.label: Normal tissue protein abundance

rna_protein_concordance.label: Rna protein concordance
rna_protein_concordance.plain_english: Does target RNA predict its protein (is RNA an adequate proxy, or must protein be measured directly)?

expression_clinical_association.label: Expression clinical association
expression_clinical_association.plain_english: Does target expression stratify patient survival in the indication (prognostic association)?

mutational_signature_context.label: Mutational signature context
mutational_signature_context.plain_english: Which mutational processes (APOBEC / MMR-deficiency / HRD / tobacco / UV / POLE / clock) shaped the indication's cohort, and which dominates?

cell_line_rna_expression.label: Cell line rna expression

alteration_role.label: Alteration role

tumor_protein_ihc_presence.label: Tumor protein ihc presence

patient_cis_coherence.label: Patient cis coherence

measured_potency_tractability.label: Measured potency tractability
measured_potency_tractability.plain_english: Is there a potent (<=1 uM) measured small-molecule ligand for target, and how deep is the chemotype series?

tahoe_drug_perturbation.label: Tahoe drug perturbation
tahoe_drug_perturbation.plain_english: Which small molecules significantly move {target}'s expression (suppress or induce), and in how many cancer lines (single-cell drug-perturbation MoA)?

tumor_elevation_breadth.label: Tumor elevation breadth

tumor_expression_distribution.label: Tumor expression distribution
tumor_expression_distribution.plain_english: How does target RNA DISTRIBUTE across an indication's tumors (per-sample: median, fraction detectable/high, shape continuous|bimodal|long_tail)?

tumor_splice_dysregulation.label: Tumor splice dysregulation
tumor_splice_dysregulation.plain_english: Is the target alternatively spliced / splice-dysregulated in the patient tumor (transcript form, not level)?

adc_tce_modality_fit.label: Adc tce modality fit
adc_tce_modality_fit.plain_english: Which biologic modalities (ADC / TCE / both / neither) are viable candidates for target?

genotype_matched_model.label: Genotype matched model

crispr_lof_dependency.label: Crispr lof dependency

signaling_network_mechanism.label: Signaling network mechanism

gene_ontology_annotation.label: Gene ontology annotation

prism_compound_activity.label: Prism compound activity

functional_gene_state.label: Functional gene state

partner_conditional_dependency.label: Partner conditional dependency
partner_conditional_dependency.plain_english: Is target dependency stratified by a partner gene's deficiency status (synthetic-lethality biomarker)?

phospho_pathway_activity.label: Phospho pathway activity

abundance_dependency_correlation.label: Abundance dependency correlation

immune_context.label: Immune context

stemness_context.label: Stemness context
stemness_context.plain_english: How stem-like / dedifferentiated is the indication's cohort (tumor mRNAsi)?

normal_tissue_rna_breadth.label: Normal tissue rna breadth
normal_tissue_rna_breadth.plain_english: In how many adult tissues is target RNA-expressed (target-selection therapeutic-window count)?

synthetic_lethal_partner.label: Synthetic lethal partner
synthetic_lethal_partner.plain_english: Does target have a curated (experimental) synthetic-lethal partner making a pooled non-dependent read untrusted?

antigen_pair_selectivity.label: Antigen pair selectivity
antigen_pair_selectivity.plain_english: For a target antigen, which partner antigen makes the most tumor-vs-NORMAL selective logic-gated (AND/OR/NOT) bispecific pair (bulk per-sample RNA)?

paralog_buffering.label: Paralog buffering
paralog_buffering.plain_english: Does a functional paralog buffer target's dependency (dual-KO delta / escape risk)?

sc_tumor_myeloid_state_expression.label: Sc tumor myeloid state expression
sc_tumor_myeloid_state_expression.plain_english: In how many pan-cancer tumour-infiltrating MYELOID cell states is target detected at single-cell resolution, and is it a myeloid-target / suppressive-TAM antigen?

exon_window.label: Exon window
exon_window.plain_english: Does the target's tumor-dominant exon show within-gene heterogeneity + a clean window suggesting an isoform-resolved epitope worth junction-level follow-up?

crispr_rnai_concordance.label: Crispr rnai concordance
crispr_rnai_concordance.plain_english: Do the two orthogonal LOF assays agree that target is required?

functional_blockade_rationale.label: Functional blockade rationale
functional_blockade_rationale.plain_english: Does binding the target produce a functional consequence (receptor antagonism / ligand sequestration / dimerization blockade) supporting a naked-antibody blockade rationale?

sc_normal_celltype_expression.label: Sc normal celltype expression
sc_normal_celltype_expression.plain_english: Single-cell RNA expression in normal tissue by cell type (pseudobulk, donor-replicate) — on-target-off-tumor safety substrate at cell-type resolution

mutation_drug_response.label: Mutation drug response
mutation_drug_response.plain_english: Are cell lines carrying an alteration in target more SENSITIVE to a drug that targets it (PRISM Log2AUC)?

shet_lof_selection.label: Shet lof selection
shet_lof_selection.plain_english: What is target's continuous dominant-LoF selection coefficient (s_het), and does it corroborate the binary gnomAD constraint call?

cell_line_protein_abundance.label: Cell line protein abundance
cell_line_protein_abundance.plain_english: What is target's mass-spec protein abundance across cancer cell lines (Gygi TMT + ProCan DIA panels)?

dependency_predictability.label: Dependency predictability
dependency_predictability.plain_english: Can target's Chronos dependency be predicted from omics (biomarker-anchored / context-driven / unpredictable)?

expression_dependency_correlation.label: Expression dependency correlation
expression_dependency_correlation.plain_english: Does target's mRNA expression correlate with its own dependency (expression-as-biomarker)?

oncogenic_pathway_alteration.label: Oncogenic pathway alteration
oncogenic_pathway_alteration.plain_english: Which oncogenic signaling pathways are frequently altered in the indication's cohort?

shed_ectodomain_liability.label: Shed ectodomain liability
shed_ectodomain_liability.plain_english: Is target's ectodomain shed as a soluble circulating decoy (antigen-sink liability for biologics)?

protein_domains_class.label: Protein domains class

tumor_vs_normal_selectivity.label: Tumor vs normal selectivity

cellline_isoform_expression.label: Cellline isoform expression
cellline_isoform_expression.plain_english: Which transcript isoform carries {target}'s expression across cancer cell lines — single-isoform-dominant or isoform-diverse?

human_genetic_safety.label: Human genetic safety
human_genetic_safety.plain_english: Does population rare-variant burden show loss of target function is harmful (WT-loss safety signal) or protective?

concepts.title: Source manifest
concepts.narration: A source manifest is one YAML record in the data-catalog describing an external dataset received whole (DepMap, TCGA, GENIE, gnomAD). It records the S3 location, per-file MD5 + size, license, provenance pipeline, and data subject — the catalog is the source-of-record for WHAT data exists and WHERE, never the bytes themselves. Everything downstream reads a manifest to find its data.

concepts.title: Method (analysis-methods)
concepts.narration: A method is deterministic compute — `fn(target=, indication=) -> summary dict` — that reads a catalog product and emits NUMBERS and categorical LABELS, never a verdict. Its output validates against a per-card summary schema at compose time, so schema drift is caught before it reaches an evidence package. Methods live in the analysis-methods repo; a card names the method that produces it.

concepts.title: Card (evidence contract)
concepts.narration: A card is the declarative contract for one piece of evidence, and the hinge of the whole framework. Its identity is (measurement_type x entity_grain) — gates PULL a measurement type, data PUSHES a provider, so a new dataset slots in without touching gate logic. It binds the product it reads (`required_inputs`), the method that produces it (`methods`), and the closed-vocabulary labels it emits (`outputs.summary_fields`). Cards emit descriptive labels only; interpretation lives in the rules layer.

concepts.title: Interpretation rule
concepts.narration: An interpretation rule maps one card LABEL to a per-modality SIGNAL, firing a named `rule_id` — e.g. "when dependency_class == common_essential -> small_molecule: killer". This is the only place a descriptive label becomes a therapeutic signal. Rules never decide a verdict; they produce the fired-rule set that a resolver reduces.

fields.rationale:
Intracellular-intrinsic targets (cytoplasmic/nuclear proteins acting cell-autonomously)
are pursued primarily via small-molecule + degrader modalities. The therapeutic
rationale requires (a) functional dependency in the indication's cell context AND
(b) for degraders, demonstrable protein presence. This rules file encodes those
modality-specific requirements as signal mappings over descriptive evi…

rules.killer_message:
Pan-essential target — no therapeutic window. Common-essential genes are required
for viability across the panel; systemic inhibition produces unacceptable toxicity
regardless of indication. Not viable as a small-molecule or degrader program.
rules.rationale:
DepMap's common_essential classification (~2000 genes, mostly housekeeping/ribosomal).
Pursuing these requires either tissue-restricted delivery (out of scope for systemic
small-molecule/degrader) or context-conditional inhibition (mutant-specific, etc.).

H fix (2026-07-20): a >=85% pan-essential fraction on a panel BELOW the coverage
floor (PAN_ESSENTIAL_MIN_PANEL_N=300) — an underpowered tiny-panel artifact, NOT a
trusted pan-essential. Symmetric top-end admissibility guard to
non-dependent-underpowered-insufficient: this must NOT fire the pan-essential VETO
(an underpowered positive is a coverage gap, not a measured pan-essential).
Checked as a distinct verdict so the functional-requirement _verdict routes it to
insufficient before the pan-essential killer. Measured-vs-null discipline.

DepMap's strongly_selective classification — dependency is highly variable across
the panel, suggesting context-specific essentiality. This is the canonical
therapeutic-window signal: some cell contexts need it, most don't.

rules.killer_message:
No functional dependency detected across the cell-line panel. Without dependency
evidence there is no rationale for therapeutic investment regardless of modality.

rules.rationale:
DepMap-power admissibility guard (2026-07-17). The POOLED pan-cancer fraction is
below the dependency floor, but a well-sampled lineage (n>=5) is concentrated-
dependent — the relevant lineage/genotype is simply UNDER-SAMPLED in DepMap
(EGFR-mut lung, FLT3-mut AML, IDH1-mut), so the pooled negative is diluted, not
trusted. This is a COVERAGE GAP (insufficient), NOT a measured negative — it must
NOT fire the non_dependent veto (measured-vs-null discipline: absence of pooled
power is not evidence-against). The lineage-scoped or mutation-stratified
dependency cards carry the real read for the concentrated context; synthesis
should surface "insufficient pan-cancer power; see lineage/mutation-stratified
evidence" rather than a false-negative veto.

Dependency signal is broad but doesn't meet the common_essential threshold (~85%
strongly-dependent). Between selective and pan-essential territory. NOT a killer
on its own — could still be a valid therapeutic-window target if lineage-selectivity
or mutation-stratification cards identify a discriminating context. Downstream cards
carry the differentiation.

concepts.title: Resolver (verdict ladder)
concepts.narration: A resolver reduces the SET of fired rule_ids to one verdict per gate. It is an ordered precedence ladder that pattern-matches only over rule_ids — deliberately not Turing-complete (no arithmetic; that lives in the card/method). It emits a verdict token plus a `driving_rule_id` provenance anchor and a `default` (usually insufficient) so exhaustiveness is provable. A single shared interpreter runs every gate, so verdicts are byte-stable.

fields.name: gate
fields.desc: The sub-skill / gate this resolver governs (matches the SUB_SKILLS short, e.g. 'dependency', 'expression', 'surface_modality').

fields.name: version

concepts.title: Skill (question + composition)
concepts.narration: A skill answers one biological question by composing a set of cards, firing their rules, and resolving a verdict. Its SKILL.md `composition` block declares data_mode, phase, cards_used, rules_scope, and status. The composed target-profile skill fans out to ~13 focused skills, inherits each sub-verdict from the shared resolver spine (never re-resolves), then adds LLM synthesis on top.

concepts.title: Evidence package / synthesis
concepts.narration: An evidence package is the terminal composed output for one target x indication. It carries the deterministic sub-verdicts, per-card evidence, governance (which manifest versions were read, with staleness flags), and a synthesis block. The LLM narration rides in DISTINCT schema slots tagged `_source: llm_synthesized`, and its recommendation is clamped by a fail-closed gate — so narrative can never move an auditable verdict.

levels.schematic:
STEP 0 · THE CARD EMITS
    CARD  pan-cancer-crispr-dependency-distribution
      dependency_class = strongly_selective        ← the decision datum
      median_chronos = -0.30 · frac_strong = 0.18  ← numerics (context)
      capsule.primary_class = dependency_class
          ├────────▶ LANE A · DECIDES              (authoritative)
          ├────────▶ LANE B · DESCRIBES / RANKS    (verdict-inert)
          └────────▶ LANE C · NARRATES             (verdict-inert)

  LANE A · DECIDES ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    A1  rule: when dependency_class ∈ {strongly_selective}
            ▸ fires strongly-selective-supportive  {small_molecule: supportive}
    A2  + rules from sibling cards  ▸  FIRED-RULE SET { … }
    A3  resolver ladder (dependency): first / priority match
            ▸ verdict = selective_dependent · driving_rule = strongly-selective-supportive
    A4  ▸ decision.json / sub_verdict  (byte-stable) ────────────┐ outputs
                                                                 │ read
  LANE B · DESCRIBES / RANKS ─────────────────────────────────  │ only,
    B1  claim_vector[DEP]: signal = strong · corroboration = low │ by C
            (RNAi conflict caps corroboration · gap → None, not 0)│
    B2  subgroup rollup: card→question→sub_group by crispr_lof_dependency      │
            confidence = agreement × power (capped by conflict)  │
    B3  certainty_by_axis  (DISJOINT — corroboration card fires  │
            no resolver rung → confidence never double-counts)   │
    B4  ▸ question table + narrator signals (display / prompt) ──┤
                                                                 │
  LANE C · NARRATES ──────────────────────────────────────────  │
    C1  evidence_capsule(card): primary_class + top_k strata +   │
            numeric/categorical anchors + conflicts (hash-stable)│
    C2  prompt = capsule ⊕ sub_verdicts(◀A4) ⊕ signals(◀B1/B4) ⊕ fired rules
    C3  enum-locked tool_use ▸ LLM PROPOSES  rec = "hold"  (_source: llm_synthesized)
    C4  CLAMP: nomination gate reads A's verdict ▸ killer ⇒ overwrite ⇒ VETO
            (_gated; original llm value retained)
    C5  ▸ PACKAGE.synthesis slot (prose, gated)  ⟂  sub_verdicts slot (= A4)

  INVARIANTS
   • A is the only decider; B and C have no back-edge into A (verdict byte-stable without them).
   • B: signal ⟂ corroboration; unmeasured → None (never averaged as 0); certainty disjoint.
   • C: LLM reads A+B as read-only text, proposes in enum-locked slots, gate clamps; two slots.

levels.title: 4 · Card → verdict — the deterministic spine
levels.subtitle: How a label becomes an auditable verdict. Rules turn labels into signals; the resolver reduces the fired SET to one verdict — pattern-match only, no arithmetic — and records which rule drove it.

stages.label: Card label
stages.plain: The closed-vocab datum the card emits.

stages.label: Rule fires
stages.plain: A rule whose `when` matches the label fires its rule_id with a per-modality signal.

stages.label: Fired-rule set
stages.plain: ALL matching rules across the gate's cards collect into a set (no arithmetic).

stages.label: Resolver ladder
stages.plain: Ordered precedence over the fired set; first/priority match wins; provable default.

stages.label: Verdict + provenance
stages.plain: One verdict token + the driving_rule_id that produced it.

stages.label: decision.json → package
stages.plain: Written to the skill's decision + the composed evidence package, byte-stable.

 │ partner-conditional-dep. │─ partner_class=moderately_dep        ─▶ partner-cond-supp │ fired
 │ crispr-rnai-concordance  │─ concordance_class=discordant        ─▶ concordance-warn  │  set

levels.title: 5 · Signals layer — beside the spine (verdict-inert)
levels.subtitle: The richer re-projection humans + the LLM read: signal separated from corroboration, gaps kept distinct from negatives, confidence held disjoint from signal. It ranks and explains; it never decides.

stages.label: Card evidence
stages.plain: The same card labels the verdict spine reads — re-projected, never re-decided.

stages.label: Claim vector
stages.plain: Orthogonal axes, each with an INDEPENDENT (signal × corroboration). unmeasured → None, so a gap is never averaged as a zero.

stages.label: Corroboration / conflict
stages.plain: A second AGREEING assay raises corroboration (never the signal); a disagreeing one caps it and surfaces a conflict.

stages.label: Subgroup rollup
stages.plain: Signals roll up card → question → sub-group by measurement_type; confidence = agreement × power, capped by conflict (not weakest-link).

stages.label: Certainty (disjoint)
stages.plain: A separate per-axis certainty sidecar — corroboration cards must fire NO verdict rung (enforced), so confidence never double-counts the verdict.

lane.label: Why it sits BESIDE the spine
steps: re-projects the same evidence for ranking + prompting
reachability proves which cards can move a verdict vs enrich it
lane.invariant: The signals layer never feeds the resolver — verdict byte-stable with or without it.

levels.title: 6 · Card → narration LLM — read-only, clamped
levels.subtitle: How prose rides on top WITHOUT touching the verdict. The LLM consumes capsules + verdicts as text, proposes in enum-locked slots, and a fail-closed gate clamps the proposal.

stages.label: Verdicts + fired rules
stages.plain: The deterministic sub-verdicts, driving rules, and rule rationales — as TEXT.

stages.label: Evidence capsules
stages.plain: Hash-stable, bounded per-card data packages (primary_class + anchors). Read-only.

stages.label: Enum-locked prompt
stages.plain: Forced structured tool_use. Recommendation + confidence are ENUM-locked so the LLM cannot free-form them.

stages.label: LLM proposes
stages.plain: Prose + a PROPOSED recommendation, every field tagged _source: llm_synthesized.

stages.label: Fail-closed gate
stages.plain: A killer sub-verdict OVERWRITES the proposal (blind axis ≠ kill; positives only raise confidence). The original is kept on record.

lane.label: Two-slot invariant
steps: deterministic spine + LLM prose live in DISTINCT schema slots
the clamp is one-directional (can only be more conservative)
lane.invariant: The LLM sees read-only text and proposes; the rules decide.

levels.title: 7 · Composed skills → downstream
levels.subtitle: Zoomed OUT: target-profile fans out to 15 skills, inherits their sub-verdicts (never re-resolves), adds clamped synthesis, and writes an evidence package that downstream registries + dashboards ingest.

stages.label: target-profile
stages.plain: The composed root. Fans out (in parallel, in-process) to 15 focused skills.

stages.label: 15 focused skills
stages.plain: Each answers one question and resolves its own verdict via the shared resolver.
stages.example: tumor-presence, tumor-selectivity, functional-requirement, mechanism-and-pharmacology, genomic-alteration-profile, differentiation-landscape …

stages.label: Inherit sub-verdicts
stages.plain: The composer INHERITS each sub-verdict from the shared spine — never re-resolves.

stages.label: Synthesis + substrate
stages.plain: Tier-3 LLM synthesis (clamped) + ground→risk→hypothesis substrate chain (verdict-inert).

stages.label: Evidence package
stages.plain: target_profile.md + nomination.json + provenance, pinned to manifest versions.

stages.label: data-products
stages.plain: The terminal output surface — one dir per target×indication.

stages.label: Downstream ingestions
stages.plain: Output registry (catalog.json/coverage), dashboards, and retrieval skills (query-target-evidence) consume the packages.

levels.title: 8 · Substrate chain — ground → risk → hypothesis
levels.subtitle: The richest downstream reading, layered on the FINISHED package. Ground cites literature; the risk roll-up's bins are a pure function of the sub-verdicts; the hypothesis is clamped to the spine's kill set.

stages.label: Evidence package
stages.plain: The finished, verdict-bearing package — the substrate chain reads it, never writes back to it.

stages.label: Ground
stages.plain: literature-risk-assessment grounds each axis against live PubMed (escalate-only, PMID-cited).

stages.label: Risk roll-up
stages.plain: Deterministic modality-conditioned 6-dim bins — a PURE function of sub_verdicts. Literature findings can only RAISE a flag, never change a bin.

stages.label: Risk assessment
stages.plain: LLM retrieval-grounded 6-dim literature read (Biological/Druggability/…). Verdict-inert display context.

stages.label: Hypothesis
stages.plain: cross-evidence-hypothesis: cited six-part reasoning, CLAMPED to a fail-closed ceiling built from the spine's hard_gates.

lane.label: Best-effort + verdict-inert
steps: default-ON in a full run; auto-skipped offline/fast
the hypothesis body replaces the exec-summary on the dashboard — but the header verdict stays the deterministic scalar
lane.invariant: The substrate enriches; the spine's hard_gates still bound it.

levels.title: 9 · Governance loop — how it stays honest
levels.subtitle: Contracts-first, top to bottom: schemas/vocab lead, validators + golden tests + drift guards enforce, and this document exposes what slips. The reason the deterministic verdict can be trusted.

stages.label: Schemas + vocab
stages.plain: Contracts-first: schemas, measurement-type + verdict-token vocabularies are authored + validated BEFORE methods/skills conform.

stages.label: Validators (CI)
stages.plain: 14 gap-detection validators enforce referential integrity — orphan rules, dangling rungs, verdict-token case-match, measurement-type rot.

stages.label: Golden tests
stages.plain: Known-target backtests against checked-in decision SNAPSHOTS (must_not_veto / abstention_expected / known_gap_expected_fail).

stages.label: Drift guards
stages.plain: Generated artifacts (this living doc, framework_health, question-hierarchies) carry --self-check / --check so a stale commit fails CI.

stages.label: This living doc
stages.plain: Surfaces every gap the validators + health rollup find in ONE ranked place — the loop, made legible.

lane.label: The invariant that makes it auditable
steps: cards emit labels · rules fire signals · resolvers decide — one shared kernel
everything else (signals, narration, substrate) is verdict-inert by construction
lane.invariant: Rules decide; everything else describes. Every override is on the record.
